capabilities: create a Things3 todo from a selected note line
toggle a todo's done state in both Obsidian and Things3
attach existing Things3 tags and note dates to created todos
link todos permanently to notes via Advanced URI and a frontmatter uid
add a backlink to the Obsidian note inside the Things3 todo
disambiguation: Not a two-way task sync: Things3-side edits never flow back into Obsidian, only Obsidian-to-Things3 pushes.
extras: The Things3 auth token is stored in plain text in the plugin folder, so the README warns against syncing or sharing plugin settings; some roadmap items (multi-line support, alternate toggle trigger) are marked impossible due to Things3 API limitations.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create or toggle Things3 todos from note lines, and Things3's URL scheme cannot push changes back.

relations.evidence: Optionally link todos via the Advanced URI plugin using a uid stored in the note's frontmatter

summary: One-way sync plugin that pushes todos, tags and dates from Obsidian lines into the Things3 task app on macOS and iOS.
